, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Pierre Berton attended the University of Toronto (Victoria College), despite the WebSurfer’s results already providing corroborating sources (e.g., Los Angeles Times obituary, Yukon Nuggets) indicating he was educated at the University of British Columbia.
